purpose: Teach: 同名/気配り/調査官/貸借/割当/局員/上半期/釈明

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者と同名の市民への誤認を避けます
lines.en: We take care to avoid misidentifying citizens who happen to share a suspect's name.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Steady pace. Opening with quiet authority. No defensiveness—a matter of procedure explained clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、市民への気配りを大事にされてますね
lines.en: I see. The police really do prioritize consideration for citizens.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slight lean-in, nodding register. Warm but formal. The tone of someone taking mental notes.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本件は調査官の専門領域です
lines.en: This case falls within the investigator's area of expertise.
lines.style: Factual, unbending. Short sentences. No apology in the delivery—stating boundaries professionally. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、不正貸借契約の捜査もされますね
lines.en: Understood. The police are also investigating the illegal lease arrangements, then.
lines.style: Careful, almost cautious affirmation. Reading the room. Respectful pause before the follow-up question. Not pushing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、応援要員の割当を調整しました
lines.en: We've adjusted the allocation of backup personnel to this operation.
lines.style: Even, procedural tone. Matter-of-fact delivery. The confidence of someone reporting completed work. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、郵便局員さんの安全も守って下さいね
lines.en: Thank you. Please make sure to protect the postal workers' safety as well.
lines.style: Sincere request beneath politeness. Slight softening—this is personal now. Genuine concern breaking through the formal register.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、上半期の犯罪統計を発表します
lines.en: We're releasing the first-half crime statistics today.
lines.style: Official announcement register. Clean, declarative. Opening with slight lift. No editorializing—just the facts being delivered.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、捜査結果の釈明会見も行われますね
lines.en: Yes. Will you be holding a press conference to clarify the investigation results?
lines.style: Formal inquiry, building rapport. Quiet recognition of the weight of what's being discussed. Attentive listener asking the next logical question.
